titulo: Pilot Study of the Safety and Efficacy of Oxandrolone in the Prevention and Treatment of Malnutrition in Infants

braco.texto: Following clinical evaluation, all patients will be receive oxandrolone in addition to their usual medications. Based upon the patient's body weight, the coordinator, PI or sub-PI will determine the appropriate dose of oxandrolone (0.1 mg/kg/dose twice daily via the buccal mucosa.)
braco.textoPt: Após avaliação clínica, todos os pacientes receberão oxandrolona além de seus medicamentos habituais. Com base no peso corporal do paciente, o coordenador, PI ou sub-PI determinará a dose apropriada de oxandrolona (0,1 mg/kg/dose duas vezes ao dia através da mucosa bucal).
